The Department of Fish and Wildlife Conservation in the College of Natural Resources and Environment at Virginia Tech invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant or Associate Professor of Mammalian Conservation Ecology. The successful candidate will develop an internationally visible research program in mammalian conservation ecology. The candidate should have a strong track record studying the conservation and ecology of wild mammal populations, with research addressing contemporary socio-environmental challenges such as climate change, emerging infectious diseases, invasive species, and habitat loss. The Department and the University are highly collaborative environments, creating the opportunity for diverse collaborations across Virginia Tech and with state and federal natural resource agencies, conservation organizations, and other partners. The position is envisioned as approximately 25% teaching, 65% research, and 10% service.

The department boasts a high-quality teaching environment that emphasizes modern pedagogical techniques and ample experiential learning opportunities. There has never been a more important time to join Southern Water. We are delivering one of the most ambitious capital investment programmes in the industry, focused on improving environmental performance, service resilience and long‑term affordability for customers.

About The Role

We have an exciting opportunity to join the Enabling Team in Engineering Technical Services (ETS)
at Southern Water as a Senior Environmental Advisor
. In this role, you will provide expert environmental risk management support across a diverse portfolio of projects, ensuring sustainable and responsible design, maintenance, and construction processes. You will play a key role in delivering environmental solutions that protect water resources, enhance ecosystems, and contribute to long-term sustainability.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Providing expert environmental advice throughout project lifecycles, from concept and design through to construction.
Leading or overseeing environmental assessments, surveys, investigations, and mitigation strategies.
Ensuring projects comply with environmental legislation, planning requirements, permits, licences, and industry best practice.
Advising on water resources, pollution prevention, waste management, and environmental permitting matters.
Managing specialist environmental consultants and contractors, ensuring high-quality technical outputs.
Supporting stakeholder engagement with regulators, local authorities, statutory bodies, landowners, and community groups.

What You’ll Bring To The Role

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical environmental knowledge with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills but most importantly, a deep passion for the environment.

A degree (or higher qualification) in Environmental Science, Environmental Management, Ecology, Geography, Environmental Engineering, or a related discipline.
Experience working within environmental consultancy, utilities, infrastructure, construction, engineering, or a similar environment.
Excellent organisational, written and verbal communication skills.
Strong knowledge of UK environmental legislation, planning processes, and environmental management practices.
Experience undertaking or managing environmental assessments and coordinating environmental inputs to projects.
Experience managing specialist consultants and coordinating multiple stakeholders.
Membership of a relevant professional institution such as ISEP, CIWEM, or equivalent.
Chartered status, or working towards chartership, would be advantageous.

Southern Water is at the forefront of transforming Britain’s water industry, investing significantly to enhance resilience, sustainability, and service excellence. With £7.8bn planned investment for 2025-30, this is an unparalleled opportunity to join a business committed to delivering a generational shift in the way water services are managed.

You will be joining at a time of significant change, working alongside a highly skilled leadership team with a clear vision for the future. We offer an environment where senior professionals can make a meaningful impact, influence major strategic decisions, and drive long-term value creation.

"At Southern Water, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. If you’re passionate about making a positive impact and think you can bring value to our team, we’d love to hear from you—even if you don’t tick every box. Your unique skills and experiences could be exactly what we need."
